synopsis: A few months after the Blood Knights destroy the Amani-driven Scourge incursion inside southern Eversong, the order proves its worth through repeated defense of the runestone boundary, dangerous Ghostlands deployments, and limited coordination with Forsaken scouts; Tranquillien and the Ghostlands remain hostile and unheld. Regular communication with Kael’thas’s forces in Outland keeps the prince’s promised future alive in Silvermoon. The Dark Portal remained closed after the old wars, and Kael’thas, Lady Vashj, and their followers reached Outland by difficult magical means after escaping Dalaran. Illidan’s power, blood elf expertise, and Outland’s engines later forced the Portal open from the far side and stabilized it as a route. Lord Sanguinar leads a small Outland delegation to receive Blood Knight power for Kael’thas’s army. Liadrin remembers Sanguinar’s brutality from the Outland campaign, and when he flaunts the Light by injuring Daric in sparring without remorse, she sees how the order may be corrupted in the prince’s service. Sanguinar’s group returns through the Portal. While Silvermoon’s Blood Knights prepare for another southern patrol, the Dark Portal snaps shut and severs contact with Outland without warning.
title: Chapter 13: Silence Beyond the Portal
